prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, company size, and which channels you need (SEO, PPC, social, content, growth marketing, creative, analytics, etc.).

If you want a quick next step, tell me about:
- Your primary goals (lead gen, brand awareness, e‑commerce sales, user acquisition, etc.)
- Main channels you care about (search, paid social, SEO, email, content, conversion rate optimization)
- Monthly/annual budget range
- Company stage and industry
- Timeline / any geographic targeting

What I can do after that:
- Recommend 3–5 San Francisco agencies well suited to your needs (range of boutique to enterprise)
- Give a short checklist / RFP template to vet them
- Provide the 6–8 key questions to ask during interviews and what red flags to watch for

If you’d rather browse first, I can also give a short list of highly regarded SF agencies by specialty — tell me which specialty you want.
